Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with default pagination (page 0, limit 10)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 10 appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/shops/1/appointments?date=2023-11-01 with no page or limit parameters.
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of up to 10 appointment reservations for shop ID 1 on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with custom page size (boundary: limit 1)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of exactly 1 appointment reservation for shop ID 1 on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with custom page size (boundary: limit 0)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request) with an error message indicating that limit must be greater than zero.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with custom page size (boundary: limit 1000, very large input)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1000 appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of up to 1000 appointment reservations for shop ID 1 on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with custom page number (boundary: page -1, one below minimum)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request) with an error message indicating that page must be zero or greater.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with custom page number (boundary: page 0, exactly at minimum)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of appointment reservations for shop ID 1 on 2023-11-01 from the first page.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with custom page number (boundary: page 999, very large input)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has fewer than 9990 appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an empty list of appointment reservations for shop ID 1 on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve appointments by worker with custom page size (boundary: limit 1)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, worker with ID 1 exists, and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of exactly 1 appointment reservation for worker ID 1 on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve appointments by customer phone with custom page size (boundary: limit 1)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, customer with phone '1234567890' exists, and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of exactly 1 appointment reservation for customer phone '1234567890' on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve appointments by customer name with custom page size (boundary: limit 1)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, customer with name 'John Doe' exists, and has at least 1 appointment reservation on 2023-11-01
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/shops/1/appointments/search?customerName=John Doe&date=2023-11-01&limit=1.
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of exactly 1 appointment reservation for customer name 'John Doe' on 2023-11-01.

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with default pagination (page 0, limit 10)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'john.doe' exists and has at least 10 appointment reservations
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/appointments?username=john.doe with no page or limit parameters.
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of up to 10 appointment reservations for customer 'john.doe'.

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with custom page size (boundary: limit 1)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'john.doe' exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a list of exactly 1 appointment reservation for customer 'john.doe'.

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with custom page size (boundary: limit 0)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'john.doe' exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request) with an error message indicating that limit must be greater than zero.

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with custom page number (boundary: page -1, one below minimum)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'john.doe' exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request) with an error message indicating that page must be zero or greater.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a shop with no appointments (empty list boundary)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has no appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 (Not Found). Response body is empty.

Title: Retrieve appointments by worker with no appointments (empty list boundary)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, worker with ID 1 exists, and has no appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 (Not Found). Response body is empty.

Title: Retrieve appointments by customer phone with no appointments (empty list boundary)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, customer with phone '1234567890' exists, and has no appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 (Not Found). Response body is empty.

Title: Retrieve appointments by customer name with no appointments (empty list boundary)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, customer with name 'John Doe' exists, and has no appointment reservations on 2023-11-01
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/shops/1/appointments/search?customerName=John Doe&date=2023-11-01.
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 (Not Found). Response body is empty.
